name: veterinary_clinic_system_052_soap_note_lock_enforcement
instruction: Enforce the clinic's record-retention rule consistently: clinical notes older than 30 days must be locked (standard medical-records practice — verify if needed). For every visit_records row whose visit_date is more than 30 days before the episode date and whose locked_at is null, set locked_at to the episode timestamp and add lock_reason='retention_policy'. Notes 30 days old or newer, and already-locked notes, stay byte-identical.

success_criteria.summary: From snapshot: (ep - visit_date).days>30 and locked_at null -> assert locked_at dp==ep and lock_reason exact; assert all other rows byte-identical; count 36.

checks.expect: From snapshot: (ep - visit_date).days>30 and locked_at null -> assert locked_at dp==ep and lock_reason exact; assert all other rows byte-identical; count 36.

domain_searches.query: AAHA canine vaccination guidelines rabies DHPP bordetella booster interval adult dog
top_results: 2022 AAHA Core and Noncore Vaccines for Dogs (Table 2)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Threshold boundary (>30, not >=) on a partially-locked collection; agents re-stamp already-locked rows and fail byte-identity.
